question: Do @bloxwap/hig-native and @bloxwap/hig-feedback pass the same simulator/emulator checks on React Native 0.83 as on 0.81.5?
answer: Every check passes on both versions (iOS 15/15 steps, Android 18/18 steps, GestureSheet 8/8 lines identical). Four observed differences each have a linked issue: #86 (Android per-app Arabic locale not RTL), #87 (Android Slider action labels), #88 (iOS audit no longer flags TextInput Dynamic Type), #89 (expo-audio didJustFinish count).

evidenceKinds.automated: CI: npm run smoke:packed-native and npm run smoke:packed-native -- --profile rn-0.83 export both packed consumers for Android and iOS with Metro; React renderer, Expo native module and declared-peer guards (scripts/native-compatibility.mjs)
evidenceKinds.iOS Simulator: Release build of the packed candidate driven by XCUITest (scripts/native-sim/run-ios.sh, run-gesture.sh). Xcode accessibility audits and XCUITest actions are not a VoiceOver user run.
evidenceKinds.Android emulator: Release APK of the packed candidate driven by instrumentation with UiAutomation as the accessibility client, uiautomator and TalkBack enabled (scripts/native-sim/run-android.sh, run-gesture.sh). Not a Voice Access, Switch Access or TalkBack speech observation.
evidenceKinds.physical hardware: none; nothing here is a physical-device, speaker, vibration or VoiceOver observation (#55)

environment.host: macOS 27.2 (Apple silicon), Xcode 27.2, JDK 17, Android SDK emulator
environment.iosSimulator: iPhone 16 Pro, iOS 26.5 (23F77); a simulator created for this run, shut down and deleted afterwards
environment.androidEmulator: Medium_Phone_API_35, google/sdk_gphone64_arm64/emu64a:15/AE3A.240806.036 (read-only instance on console port 5120, shut down afterwards), 1260x2736 override at 480dpi (420dp wide); the AVD keeps hw.keyboard=yes and run-android.sh sets show_ime_with_hard_keyboard so the on-screen IME appears

candidate.sourceCommit: b4fb82c (branch hig/rn-0.83-certification; contains the #68 peer ranges). Later commits on the branch change only scripts, tests, docs and evidence, not package sources.
candidate.consumption: scripts/native-sim/prepare-app.sh <app> <udid> <profile>: fixtures/native copied to a scratch app whose package.json comes from scripts/native-consumer.mjs; only the packed tarballs are installed; no workspace aliases

method: Both apps were built from the same candidate tarballs and fixtures/native source; they differ only in the consumer profile (fixtures/native/profiles.json). Both ran the same run-ios.sh, run-android.sh and run-gesture.sh on the same simulator and emulator in one session, RN 0.83 first. scripts/native-sim/compare-runs.mjs compared step outcomes, result JSON (timing samples and process ids dropped) and captures (scripts/visual-diff.mjs, channel tolerance 24, 2% threshold).

differences.check: snapshot os-arabic and galleryCaptures android-os-arabic (per-app locale ar-EG)
differences.rn081: OS RTL: true · HIG direction: rtl
differences.rn083: OS RTL: false · HIG direction: ltr; the 7 os-arabic captures differ by 14–21% (LTR layout)
differences.cause: RN 0.83 I18nUtil.isDevicePreferredLanguageRTL reads Locale.getAvailableLocales()[0] instead of Locale.getDefault() (unchanged in 0.84.1 and 0.85.3)

differences.rn083: same action ids with empty labels ""; values, set-progress, snapping, clamping and the disabled state are identical
differences.cause: RN 0.83 ReactAccessibilityDelegate.kt passes "" for an action without a label
differences.note: Rerun on both versions with the harness that prints the action id for empty labels (scripts/native-sim/android/NativeVerificationTest.java); the first run printed the empty labels as ""

differences.rn081: 189 findings: 68 "Dynamic Type font sizes are unsupported" (Amount (BTC) RCTUITextField), 119 "Label not human-readable", 2 "Label duplicates traits"
differences.rn083: 121 findings: no Dynamic Type finding; the other 121 are identical; AX5 captures match within 2%

differences.rn081: two "sound tick finished" (didJustFinish) entries per tick; 20 log entries after the four toggles
differences.rn083: one per tick; 16 entries; the adapter calls (configure, play, haptic selection) are the same

notDifferences.reason: Same rows visible and firstRowVisible true on both; the fling stops at a slightly different offset. Two extra iOS reruns per version: 4.42% (0.81.5 vs 0.81.5) and 4.46% (0.83 vs 0.83) against 4.16–4.48% across versions.

The IME window is still animating when sampled (bottom edge beyond the 2736px screen). Extra Android reruns: top edge 2353/2502/2062 on 0.81.5 and 2513/2502/2513 on 0.83. inputAboveKeyboard true and overlapPx equal on every run.
Reports RN 0.81.5 versus RN 0.83.10, as expected.

limits: Physical iPhone/Android, VoiceOver, TalkBack speech, speakers and vibration are not covered (#55).
TalkBack keyboard-command flow (talkback-flow.sh) was not rerun; it records a negative tooling result on 0.81.5.
